newsitem.title: USA: Portec sees moderate growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Portec sees moderate growth in 1997.

text.p: Portec Inc said Wednesday it expects its businesses to show moderate growth in 1997, in line with the general economy.
"We believe that a number of positive opportunities will enable Portec's businesses to show moderate growth in the coming year," President M.T. Yonker said in a statement.
In materials handling, the company's specialty conveyor business should benefit from a $14 billion multi-year automation program by the U.S. Postal Service, he said.
However, the recycling conveyor backlog at the company's Countec operation has declined in response to temporary but significant declines in market prices for recycled materials, he said.

"In our railroad products segment," Yonker added, "the Canadian railway industry is experiencing a recovery after several years of restructuring, but in the U.S., recent or pending consolidation of major rail carriers is delaying certain spending programs."
Yonker said Portec will continue to pursue acquisitions to supplement internal growth.
Portec, a manufacturer of engineered products, today reported higher fourth-quarter sales and earnings.
